name: fmp_technical_bbands
description:
Daily Bollinger Bands (moving average with upper and lower bands) series for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/bbands as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL), period (integer, look-back length in bars; sent only when given, schema default 14).
Other indicators: the fmp_technical_* tools (sma, ema, wma, dema, tema, rsi, macd, bbands, stoch, adx, williams, stddev); raw prices: fmp_historical_price.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": 14}

period.description: Look-back length in bars (sent only when given)
